about: LH035 candidates without a row in instruments.json, each with its class and reason. A row is included when the pages read show data, link to data files, or describe the data as public, published, free or openly licensed. 'undetermined' = documentation read, but the pages read put the data behind an account, request, credentials or subscription without saying any is free, or say nothing of its availability, so the brief's inclusion rule could not be applied; 'unreadable' = the instrument's pages could not be read in this run (inconclusive, not excluded); 'excluded' = fails an inclusion rule, with the reason. Read on 2026-11-02; the four still without a row were read again on 2026-11-05 (raw curl reads in data/reads-2026-11-05/), and the eight settled then are rows I41 to I48 in instruments.json.

rows.name: USC/ISI ANT datasets (censuses, hitlists, outages, Trinocular)
rows.reason: Still undetermined on 5 November (raw reads). The list of all datasets says they "are available through the LANDER project's participiation in the PREDICT program , or on request through the e-mail address listed below"; the requests page asks for the datasets wanted, the research project, "e-mail sent from your institution" and a justification, and says "You will need to sign the data use agrement". No page read says whether access is free or that any dataset is public. The datasets page states censuses that "ping every allocated IP address one time over about two months", "2 censuses every 2-4 months since 2006", and "We used to provide geolocation data but no longer can".

rows.name: ICANN Centralized Zone Data Service (CZDS)
rows.origin: c (ICANN's public data announcement, search L4b result 2, not opened; CZDS page read directly)
rows.reason: Still undetermined on 5 November (raw reads). An account and each registry's approval are needed: "Every new gTLD Registry is required to provide zone data to approved requesters (e.g. law enforcement agents, IP attorneys, researchers)"; the terms of 30 September 2013 grant "a nonexclusive, nontransferable, limited right to access and use for any legal purpose", forbid redistribution without the registry's consent and limit access to "no more than once per 24-hour period". No page read states a cost or a fee, either way. Covers "participating generic Top-Level Domains (gTLDs)"; for others, "contact the Registry Operator directly".
